title: JBU vs Messiah: tuition, size, location
summary: John Brown University (JBU) versus Messiah University (Messiah). Also searched as Messiah vs JBU. Scorecard table is sourced; prose is checked against those facts. UniRepository is not affiliated with either school.

sections.heading: How they differ
paragraphs: John Brown University (JBU) and Messiah University are both private nonprofit institutions, as indicated by their ownership codes reported by College Scorecard. JBU is located in Siloam Springs and has an undergraduate enrollment of 1,471 students, while Messiah University is situated in Mechanicsburg with a larger undergraduate population of 2,259. Tuition costs also differ between the two, with JBU charging $31,756 for in-state students compared to Messiah's $42,240. These distinctions highlight differences in size, location, and tuition between JBU vs Messiah.

sections.heading: Cost
paragraphs: When comparing the cost of attendance at John Brown University (JBU) versus Messiah University, tuition rates are a significant factor. Both institutions charge the same tuition for in-state and out-of-state students, with JBU's tuition set at $31,756 and Messiah's at $42,240. This indicates that JBU offers a lower tuition rate compared to Messiah University. Additionally, the median debt for students who complete their programs differs between the two schools. Graduates from JBU have a median debt of $21,250, whereas those from Messiah University carry a higher median debt of $25,621. These figures provide insight into the financial commitments associated with attending each university, reflecting differences in tuition costs and student debt burdens between JBU vs Messiah.
